component.name: Universal Transliterator
component.summary: Type in Roman letters, get Unicode text in 42 languages — offline

description.p: Universal Transliterator is a two-pane editor: type Roman letters on the left and get editable Unicode text on the right. It covers all 22 scheduled languages of India plus Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Greek, Cyrillic languages, Armenian, Georgian, Amharic and Tigrinya.

Indic languages use the AI4Bharat IndicXlit model running locally, or exact ITRANS / IAST rules. Mandarin uses Rime and Japanese uses libkkc. Alternatives can be picked for any word and are remembered. Text you edit in the output is kept while you keep typing. Nothing is sent over the network.

New GitHub-style interface, alternatives for every word, learned choices, edit-preserving output, session restore, ten more languages, exact ITRANS/IAST mode, script conversion and a command-line mode.
Two-pane workflow and fully offline neural Indic conversion.
